scope: five shared control properties on each learner; ten source reviews, not full parameter/runtime acceptance

records.owner: learner configuration; persisted choice of legacy/native control path
records.setter_behavior: Reject values outside1/2. If NativeTrainingOwned, reject a different version. When invoked and accepted, set Ready=false; stored value changes afterward in UProperty.
records.build_effect: 1 selects legacy unless an explicit native owner already holds the model.2 parses/validates configured native model and plan through PrepareConfiguredNativeOwner. Public Build remains true; typed service/failure diagnostics determine validity.
records.reset_effect: Native Reset hooks do not restore version1; Default explicitly restores1.
records.persistence: Public parameter; absence in an old configuration retains Default1. Not an algorithm/model checkpoint.
records.mode_scope: legacy1 and configured2; explicit native API ownership also guards the graph independently of version
pending: Full property-specific Load/Copy/Build and binding matrix; current code/old legacy behavior must remain distinguished.

records.allowed_values: Strict configured-native schema1 or2 when ControllerVersion2; empty is the legacy default, not a valid native declaration.
records.owner: immutable configured ModelSpec/training declaration, interpreted by native configured owner
records.setter_behavior: Reject a changed declaration after ConfiguredModelInitialized with NativeModelDeclaration. Reject setter invocation during capturing/searching. Otherwise mark Ready=false; parsing occurs in Build, not setter. Same-value assignment can be elided by generic equality checks before setter.
records.build_effect: Parse strict JSON; validate topology, effective generator and optional-mode support; construct through storage only when declaration absent. Invalid configuration is a typed failure, not a false Build return.
records.reset_effect: Reset preserves declaration/model; Default clears the text and configured owner. Internal lifecycle scopes distinguish implicit Reset from user Reset.
records.persistence: Parameter text is not the full learned-model archive. Once a graph is declared, editing JSON is not a supported live retarget/checkpoint operation.
records.mode_scope: Used by configured2, not an active experimental factor for legacy1. Schema1 keeps one N0 observation; schema2 requires N0 repeats2..128; N1 repeated policy rejected.
pending: Full imported/declaration/version/binding matrix and all optional mode combinations.

records.owner: native construction/import guard; not a user training factor
records.setter_behavior: Registered without a component setter. Generic property assignment alone does not validate graph or force Ready=false.
records.build_effect: A true marker without NativeModelDeclaration fails with configured_trained_model_requires_explicit_state_import instead of silently cold-building over saved graph. Successful configured construction sets it true via native owner.
records.reset_effect: Native Reset does not declare the model untrained. Default clears marker and ownership.
records.persistence: Has both parameter/state flags; existing Copy-without-state controls retain the parameter marker to prevent accidental cold replacement. Marker is not a certificate, full graph, or controller checkpoint.
records.mode_scope: Service guard for native configured/imported state; do not sweep or manually use it to authorize an existing graph.
pending: Full saved graph/storage/lifecycle combinations; a true marker alone is never transfer proof.

records.owner: management policy for local training request, not convergence status
records.setter_behavior: Reject values outside0/1; reset legacy CountIteration and IsFirstBeat when setter is invoked. Does not itself rebuild the physical model.
records.build_effect: No physical ModelSpec/profile replacement follows from this setter alone. Native live control snapshots bind the management policy separately from search outcome.
records.reset_effect: Native Reset hooks do not restore default0; Default explicitly assigns0.
records.persistence: Public parameter, separate from TrainingStatus/certificate/recognition score.
records.mode_scope: 0 may automatically clear a local request after terminal training/finalization.1 retains external control. Need=false is not evidence of Exact or successful recognition.
pending: Ownership guards of all terminal/error writes and all binding variants; changing mode mid-probe is not certified merely because the setter accepts0/1.

records.owner: local request unless a property provider supplies it; provider remains owner of external request
records.setter_behavior: NativeRecognition rejects true. Native false calls ExternalStop when native training owns control; false cancels an owned standalone probe. A local false→true native request clears prior intent/control/probe transient state. Legacy setter has distinct threshold/iteration behavior. Generic source/binding dispatch precedes this setter.
records.build_effect: Configured cold construction preserves the requested value around native model construction; it must not infer trained state or convergence from this flag.
records.reset_effect: Explicit native Reset clears transient control in ABeforeReset while preserving model/declaration; it is not Default or reset-to-untrained. Generic bindings can bypass the local setter, so controller also reads the request on native ticks.
records.persistence: Public request parameter. Not a saved TrainingCertificate or complete checkpoint; frozen evaluation must not be enabled by toggling it alone.
records.mode_scope: Both calculate modes and both controllers; normal connected SetPointer reads provider and ignores local SetDataDirect. ExternalDataSource has separate forwarding semantics.
pending: No production non-null ExternalDataSource assignment was found in reviewed tree; do not call hypothetical forwarding a reproduced current-model failure. Audit unguarded automatic calls separately before any change to generic Rdk semantics.

open_audit_questions.description: Some automatic terminal/error writes do not guard UsesExternalDataSource when live finalization is absent. Normal SetPointer ignores local writes. The protected ExternalDataSource forwarding branch exists, but no production assignment to non-null was found; the reviewed tree has only a derived inspection test exposer. Do not invent a runtime reproduction using unsafe casts or change Rdk forwarding semantics to hide a learner ownership question.

limitations: No new numerical/runtime tests were run for this source ledger. Existing controls cover subsets only.
Historical source_inventory.json retains its own original snapshot and pending flags; this ledger does not silently mark all inventory rows accepted.
All other public parameters remain outside this ten-record review.
